Q6111.reason: The ordinance is content-neutral and serves an important interest (litter control), so under O'Brien it can apply to expressive littering without suppressing the message.

Q5735.reason: Under 28 U.S.C. § 1441 only a defendant may remove, so the plaintiff's removal is defective and the federal court would remand the entire case.

Q5651.reason: The ad's express description of the car as a 1964 model is an express warranty that an "as is" disclaimer cannot negate, so the disclaimer is not fully effective.
